title: CRITICAL: real glyph outlines in published SWFs — text is currently invisible in Ruffle
description:
Found by the 0519 capstone (recorded in CLAUDE.md Learnings but never tasked): packages/swf/src/fonts.ts emits DefineFont with EMPTY placeholder glyph shapes, so every DefineText/DefineEditText in a published SWF renders as nothing in Ruffle. Text is a core Flash 8 pillar (docs/06) and this blocked the capstone's score-TextField assertion. Scope: emit real vector glyph outlines — parse a real font (embed an open-licensed font, e.g. a metrically-sane sans, or parse system TTF via an opentype-style parser) and write DefineFont3 glyph SHAPE records + advance/layout tables (cross-check ruffle/swf/src/read.rs font parsing for exact record layout); ensure DefineEditText UseOutlines path and DefineText glyph indexing both work. Acceptance (runtime, not bytes): an e2e spec publishes a movie with a TextField containing known text and asserts it renders visibly in Ruffle (pixel diff vs blank > threshold), evidence pasted here.

--- ORACLE MID-FLIGHT NOTE ---
Scratch debris attributed to this work: packages/swf/src/__tests__/zzdump.test.ts (side-effecting 'test' that writes /tmp/big.swf and runs in the suite) and apps/desktop/render-tmp.mjs. Delete both before closing — do not commit debug scaffolding. Current known failure state for reference: glyphoutline.test.ts expects fillStyle0Set=true but glyph SHAPE records aren't setting fillStyle0 (glyphs use a single implicit fill style — check ruffle/swf read.rs Glyph parsing: glyph shapes have NumFillBits=1 and records reference fill style 1).
